description: This file defines indexes and an index provider for OpenIdApplication entities using YesSql in OrchardCore, including index classes for application ID, logout URI, redirect URI, and role name, as well as the logic to describe how these indexes are created and reduced.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationIndex
classes.description: Index for storing application ID and client ID for OpenIdApplication.

classes.name: OpenIdAppByLogoutUriIndex
classes.description: Index for counting applications by logout redirect URI.

classes.name: OpenIdAppByRedirectUriIndex
classes.description: Index for counting applications by redirect URI.

classes.name: OpenIdAppByRoleNameIndex
classes.description: Index for counting applications by role name.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides index descriptions for OpenIdApplication, including mapping and reduction logic.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how indexes are created and reduced for OpenIdApplication entities.
